plan.title: Kids' Progress Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Improvement from baseline to endline by location and coach

panels.title: Total children
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM baseline UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM endline

panels.title: Average score by site
panels.sql: SELECT "Location" AS x, AVG("Shuttle run sec") AS y FROM baseline GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT "Location" AS x, AVG("Shuttle run sec") AS y FROM endline GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Monthly trend
panels.sql:
SELECT month, SUM(amount) AS total FROM (
  SELECT strftime('%Y', "DOB") AS month, SUM("Age") AS amount FROM baseline GROUP BY 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT strftime('%Y', "DOB") AS month, SUM("Age") AS amount FROM endline GROUP BY 1
) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 children by improvement
panels.sql:
SELECT "Child name", "Coach", ("Age" - "Age") AS improvement FROM (
  SELECT "Child name", "Coach", "Age" FROM baseline
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "Child name", "Coach", "Age" FROM endline
) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY improvement DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The dashboard visualizes the overall growth of participants across locations and coaches. The KPI shows the combined count of children recorded at baseline and endline. A bar chart compares average shuttle run times by location, highlighting where performance gains are most notable. A line chart tracks monthly age trends to reveal seasonal patterns in participation. The table lists the top ten children based on calculated improvement scores.
